content_zh:
刺耳嘈杂的乌鸦于空中飞行，它盗贼一般敏锐的眼睛，在这片辽阔的山谷中划过。
它很快找到了目标，四下转动的眼睛避开夕阳，向着下方落去。
波荡着残余红光的夕阳逐渐向着地平线没去，随着夕阳落下，一点点顺着西方森林边缘浮现的两轮皎月，替代着最后一抹白日余晖。
那黯蓝色的皎洁圆月与于它上方不远的金色残月，交相辉映间把夜幕带给这片古老的大地。
宽阔又散发着恶臭的荒芜山谷内，冒着黑灰色烟雾的残破树木上落满了呱呱聒噪的乌鸦。
鸦群们密密麻麻，遮住初生之月的光芒，它们拍动翅膀，尽情庆贺。
因为这片荒芜的山谷中，满是人类的尸体，乌鸦们从空中俯冲而下，沉重的双爪砸在冰冷且黏腻的尸群中。
推开死人的头盔，啄掉尸体的眼睛，尖利的鸟喙避开尸体的盔甲，拽开盔甲缝隙中的锁子甲伤口，撕扯尸体的皮肉与内脏。
它们高叫着，大快朵颐这顿神灵赐给它们的盛宴。
乌鸦的前菜，主菜和甜点，就是这些身穿红白色制服的人类士兵，以及他们尸体中，混合层叠黄色制服的敌国士兵。
满山丘躺满的双方士兵尸体混在一起，在碎肢和内脏的融合下，铺满了大地。
长矛与磨损的剑盾在月光照射下散发寒光，燃烧着的焦黑尸体和人类肠子内的臭味使人难以忍受。
黏腻堆成山的尸体中，一只沾满干涸血液的人手猛地从中挣脱而出。
惊飞了那本吞食一半死人大脑的乌鸦，受惊了的鸦群吵闹的大片飞起，那万千黑鸦甚至将一蓝一金两轮月光遮住。
几次推动颤抖，另一只手也从尸体缝隙内挤了出来，两只手配合着，将挤压手臂的沉重尸体推落于层叠的尸山。
瘦弱的手臂挣脱后，紧接着是一个人类的费力哼叫着用后背顶掉压在身上的尸体，几分钟后，那人才从尸山中钻出。
那人身材瘦弱，高挑，红白色的瑞文盖德帝国军火枪手的制服，于那人身上显得肥大且不合身。
帝国士兵的制服也破损了，露出一块一块的空洞，透着里面染血的锁子甲，闪烁银光的左肩铁质肩甲，坠着那人身子朝左边歪，最后使得那人摔在尸体上。
“呼......呼.......呼......”
难以有节奏的粗喘声从红色方巾后传出，瘦弱的手臂连续几次尝试，才虚弱的拽下脸前挡住的方巾。

反手用力的推掉压在身上的沉重桶盔，呼吸终于畅通后，那人两手按在尸体上，撑着自己坐了起来。
随着桶盔咣当咣当的滚下尸山，月光下，坐于尸体之上的人，身体曲线逐渐清晰。
淡红色的长发在汗水与血水的浸染下，粘在一起散落肩上，洁白的皮肤上，一股股鲜血顺着脖子左侧淌进衣领，灌入胸口。
女人的疲惫喘息和咳嗽于她口中不时响起，她那淡紫色的双瞳扫视战场。
死寂一般的山丘，只有她一个人类的声音回荡，坐在尸体上的女人心脏跳动逐渐放缓，与她之前作战时的激动判若两人。
她抹了把脸上的血污，将并不柔美反而有些尖锐的微弯眉毛上的血痂，轻轻抠了下来，落在细长上翘的睫毛上。
女人眨眨眼，很是不雅的用手指捏住挺拔的小鼻子，匀称的鼻翼随之用力。
“噗————”
带着血水和鼻涕的混合物从她的鼻子中喷涌而出，喷溅在身侧一名死不瞑目的士兵脸上。
女人瞟了眼那满眼惊恐的年轻人尸体脸上的鼻涕，颤抖着因血液染红的嘴唇，嘴唇线条在哆嗦中，女人扭过头不再看那和自己岁数差不多大的小伙子。
她挣扎着摘下双手的镶铁护臂与手套，两手绕在背后，卡在后背的木铁火枪扔在一边，她咬紧牙关，按压自己的脖颈左侧，阻止血液继续流淌而出。
回想着清晨站在人群中的她，随着帝国火枪手方阵重整，战马嘶吼，军官们呐喊着前进，士兵们沉重的喘息。
敌国士兵们冲向自己，她保持着镇静，战斗持续到中午，她的同僚们以压倒性战斗的碾压着敌军。
然而，在战斗胜利后没多久，当敌国的骑兵突然从山丘另一边的森林中冲出，当远方山丘后冒出密密麻麻的黄色制服士兵。
帝国军前进的士兵们，在震惊与恐惧中被冲散了阵线，她也在人群的裹挟中，绝望的看到敌国士兵们挥舞着长矛长剑，誓要杀死她们这群入侵家园的侵略者。
她头一次感受到了慌乱，这次战斗不该有如此之多的敌国士兵，不该有敌国的骑兵出现，开战前她的火枪队队长傲慢的向手下们告知。
“泰威尔王国的野蛮人们是不会预料到我们会出现在这！
打起精神来！
蛆虫们！
让我们为皇帝带回荣耀！”
content_en:
The noisy crow flew in the air, and its sharp eyes like thieves passed through this vast valley.
It quickly found its target, and its eyes that moved around avoided the setting sun and fell downwards.
The setting sun with its remaining red light gradually disappeared towards the horizon. As the setting sun set, two bright moons appeared little by little along the edge of the western forest, replacing the last ray of daylight.
The dim blue bright full moon and the golden waning moon not far above it complement each other and bring night to this ancient land.
In the vast and stinky barren valley, the broken trees emitting black and gray smoke are covered with croaking crows.
The crows were so dense that they blocked out the light of the newborn moon. They flapped their wings in celebration.
Because this desolate valley was filled with human corpses, the crows swooped down from the sky and smashed their heavy claws into the cold and sticky corpses.
Pushing open the dead man's helmet, pecking out the corpse's eyes, avoiding the corpse's armor with its sharp beak, pulling open the chainmail wounds in the gaps in the armor, and tearing the corpse's flesh, flesh and internal organs.
They screamed and feasted on the feast given to them by the gods.
Crow's appetizer, main course and dessert are these human soldiers in red and white uniforms, and among their corpses are enemy soldiers in yellow uniforms.
The corpses of soldiers from both sides lying all over the hills were mixed together, and the ground was covered with the fusion of broken limbs and internal organs.
The spears and worn swords and shields glowed coldly in the moonlight, and the stench of the burning black corpses and human intestines was unbearable.
Among the mountains of sticky corpses, a human hand covered in dried blood suddenly broke free.
The crow that had eaten half of the dead man's brain was frightened away. The frightened crows flew up in a noisy large area. The thousands of black crows even blocked the two rounds of moonlight, one blue and one gold.
After pushing and trembling several times, the other hand squeezed out from the gap in the corpse. The two hands cooperated to push the heavy corpse squeezing the arm down onto the mountain of corpses.
After the thin arms broke free, a human groaned with difficulty and used his back to push away the corpse on top of him. After a few minutes, the man emerged from the mountain of corpses.
The man was thin and tall, and the red and white Rivengard Imperial Army Musketeer's uniform looked fat and ill-fitting on him.
The imperial soldier's uniform was also torn, with holes exposed, revealing the blood-stained chainmail, and the silver-gleaming iron shoulder armor on his left shoulder, which tilted the man's body to the left, causing him to fall onto the corpse.
"Huh...huh...huh..."
Rough and unrhythmic breathing came from behind the red scarf. His thin arms tried several times before weakly pulling off the scarf in front of his face.
He pushed off the heavy bucket helmet that was pressing on his body with his backhand. After finally breathing freely, the man put his hands on the body and pushed himself to sit up.
As the barrel helmet rolled down the mountain of corpses with a clanging clang, under the moonlight, the body curves of the person sitting on the corpse gradually became clearer.
The long, light red hair was stained by sweat and blood, sticking together and scattered on the shoulders. On the white skin, streams of blood flowed down the left side of the neck, into the collar, and poured into the chest.
The woman's tired panting and coughing sounded from her mouth from time to time, and her lavender eyes scanned the battlefield.
Only her human voice echoed in the deathly silent hills. The heartbeat of the woman sitting on the corpse gradually slowed down, completely different from the excitement she felt during the previous battle.
She wiped the blood on her face, gently picked out the blood scab on her slightly curved eyebrows that were not soft but rather sharp, and landed on her slender upturned eyelashes.
The woman blinked and pinched her straight little nose with her fingers in an inelegant way, then tightened her shapely nose.
"Pfft——"
A mixture of blood, water and snot spurted out of her nose, splatteringOn the face of a soldier beside him who was still staring at death.
The woman glanced at the snot on the face of the frightened young man's corpse, her trembling lips stained red with blood, and the lines of her lips were trembling. She turned her head and stopped looking at the young man who was about the same age as herself.
She struggled to take off the iron arm guards and gloves on her hands, wrapped her hands behind her back, and threw aside the wooden and iron musket stuck in her back. She gritted her teeth and pressed the left side of her neck to stop the blood from continuing to flow.
Thinking back to her standing in the crowd in the early morning, as the imperial musketeer phalanx reorganized, the horses roared, the officers shouted and advanced, and the soldiers breathed heavily.
The enemy soldiers rushed towards her, but she remained calm. The battle continued until noon, and her colleagues crushed the enemy troops with an overwhelming battle.
However, not long after the battle was won, the enemy's cavalry suddenly rushed out of the forest on the other side of the hill, and densely packed yellow uniformed soldiers emerged from behind the hill in the distance.
The advancing soldiers of the Imperial Army were dispersed in shock and fear. She was also surrounded by the crowd, desperate to see the enemy soldiers brandishing spears and swords, vowing to kill them, the invaders who invaded their homeland.
For the first time, she felt panic. There should not be so many enemy soldiers in this battle, and there should not be enemy cavalry. Before the battle, her musketeer captain arrogantly informed his subordinates.
“The barbarians of the Taweil Kingdom would not have expected us to appear here!
Cheer up!
Maggots!
Let us bring glory to the Emperor! "
